I'm so sorry you're carrying all of this while recovering from childbirth and caring for two children. What you're feeling is completely valid—exhaustion, body changes, and lack of partnership would overwhelm anyone. Your husband's threats and refusal to seek help are unfair and emotionally harmful, especially during this vulnerable time.

You don't need his permission to seek support. Consider reaching out to your doctor about how you're feeling, as postpartum struggles are common and treatable. Individual therapy can help you process your situation and build coping strategies. Connecting with trusted friends, family, or a postpartum support group can also reduce the isolation you're feeling. You deserve care and respect, and there are people who want to help you find your footing again.
